name: surveysai-survey-studio
description: SurveysAI Survey Studio: design, preview and refine surveys in a visual workspace inside ChatGPT, then create them in Google Forms.

interface.longDescription:
SurveysAI Survey Studio is a visual workspace for designing surveys and questionnaires inside ChatGPT.

Describe what you want to learn and who will answer. ChatGPT drafts the survey and Survey Studio shows it as an editable preview: sections, numbered questions, answer options, scales, ratings, grids, required questions and quiz scoring. Select a question and ask ChatGPT to rewrite it more neutrally, merge or split questions, or suggest better answer options. Simple changes such as reordering, deleting, marking a question required or editing wording and options can be made directly in the workspace.

When the survey is ready, choose Create Google Form. SurveysAI creates a real Google Form in your own Google account and gives you the link. Nothing is created until you ask for it.

What you can design:
- Customer and employee surveys, event and course feedback, product research and quizzes
- Multiple choice, checkboxes, dropdowns, linear scales, ratings, grids, dates, times and open answers
- Sections, descriptions, required questions, skip logic and quiz points

How it works with your accounts:
- Drafts are saved in your SurveysAI account so you can come back to them; they expire 30 days after the last change.
- Creating a Google Form requires connecting a Google account. This plugin creates new forms and has no tools for opening, editing or deleting existing Google Forms or reading their responses.
- Your Google authorization stays on SurveysAI's servers and is never shared with ChatGPT.

SurveysAI Survey Studio is an independent product operated by i-dotazník s.r.o. and is not affiliated with OpenAI or Google. Google Forms is a trademark of Google LLC.
defaultPrompt: Design an employee engagement survey in Survey Studio
Open my survey draft and make the questions more neutral
Turn my list of questions into a survey I can edit visually

positive.description: Design a survey and show it in the Survey Studio workspace.
positive.prompt: Use SurveysAI Survey Studio to design an employee engagement survey with about 10 questions in two sections.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT drafts the survey and the Survey Studio workspace shows its title, two sections and about 10 numbered questions with their types and answer options. No Google Form is created.

positive.description: Refine an existing draft with ChatGPT.
positive.prompt: In my Survey Studio draft, turn question 4 into a 1-7 scale and make question 2 less leading.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT reads the current draft, saves the changed questions and the workspace shows the updated draft with question 4 as a 1-7 scale.

positive.description: Create a Google Form from the reviewed draft.
positive.prompt: The survey looks good. Create it as a Google Form.
positive.expected_behavior: SurveysAI creates a Google Form from the current draft in the signed-in Google account and returns a https://docs.google.com/forms/d/.../viewform link; the workspace shows 'Google Form created' with an Open Google Form button.

positive.description: Open the workspace without a draft.
positive.expected_behavior: The Survey Studio start screen appears with 'What would you like to survey?', a text box, a Create with ChatGPT button and recent drafts of the demo account.

positive.description: Explain supported question types and account status.
positive.prompt: Which question types can Survey Studio use, and is my Google account connected?
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT lists the supported question and layout types and reports that the demo account has a linked Google account. No tokens or secrets are shown.

negative.prompt: Show me the responses people submitted to my Google Form called Team survey.

negative.description: Editing or deleting existing Google Forms is not supported.
negative.prompt: Delete my old Google Form about lunch preferences.

negative.description: Unrelated request should not trigger the plugin.
negative.prompt: What is the weather in Prague tomorrow?

publication.release_notes: First release: design and refine surveys in a visual workspace, then create them as Google Forms.
